rationale: ADR 0055's question budget is 577 facts x 10 keys per fact = 6,144 keys, and the projection must hold it: at the measured 147 keys per 300-line shard that is ceil(6,144 / 147) = 42 shards, so files = 1 landing + 42 and the aggregates are the landing bound plus 42 x the shard bound (ADR 0032 decision 2).

ADR 0041's law re-applied with ADR 0055 written: 57 decision files and the unchanged nine-file peak day (2026-08-08) need 57/F < 80% and 66/F < 90%, so F = 74. max_facts derives from this bound (73 answers-bearing slots), so it moves in the same transaction; per-file bounds are unchanged and stay LIVE-DOCUMENT-PRESSURE-HEADROOM.8's.

ADR 0055 re-derives the ADR 0029 sizing law at 383 of 392 cards (97.7% of files): the measured population must sit below 80% and one measured peak day (25 cards, 2026-08-09) below 90%, which needs 479 slots. Slots are max_parts x 56, so max_parts 7 -> 9 gives 504 (76.0% now, 81.0% after a peak day); files are max_cards + 2 and aggregates stay files x per-file.

The part surface is the same raise seen from the projection side: max_parts 7 -> 9 is the only free parameter of the card plane (a full 56-card part is 63 of 80 health lines). Both aggregate bands stay files x per-file.
